proof_body:
by
  intro α β A B t
  have hα : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => α * s) (α * 1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul α
  have hβ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => β * s) (β * 1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul β
  have key : ∀ C D : ℝ, HasDerivAt
      (fun s => Real.exp (α * s) * (C * Real.cos (β * s) + D * Real.sin (β * s)))
      (Real.exp (α * t) * (α * 1) * (C * Real.cos (β * t) + D * Real.sin (β * t)) +
        Real.exp (α * t) * (C * (-Real.sin (β * t) * (β * 1)) +
          D * (Real.cos (β * t) * (β * 1)))) t := fun C D =>
    hα.exp.mul ((hβ.cos.const_mul C).add (hβ.sin.const_mul D))
  exact ⟨(key A B).congr_deriv (by ring),
    (key (α * A + β * B) (α * B - β * A)).congr_deriv (by ring)⟩
target_source: ∀ (α β A B t : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (α * s) * (A * Real.cos (β * s) + B * Real.sin (β * s))) (Real.exp (α * t) * ((α * A + β * B) * Real.cos (β * t) + (α * B - β * A) * Real.sin (β * t))) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (α * s) * ((α * A + β * B) * Real.cos (β * s) + (α * B - β * A) * Real.sin (β * s))) (2 * α * (Real.exp (α * t) * ((α * A + β * B) * Real.cos (β * t) + (α * B - β * A) * Real.sin (β * t))) - (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) * (Real.exp (α * t) * (A * Real.cos (β * t) + B * Real.sin (β * t)))) t
